<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <Sequence>
      <Parallel success_count="-1" failure_count="1">
        <Sequence>
          <ExecuteTrajectory name="weld_robot1_W01" robot_ns="robot1" operation_id="W01" operation_type="weld" trajectory="{traj_robot1_W01}" hold_duration_s="0.5" velocity_scale="1.0" has_interlock="false"/>
          <ExecuteTrajectory name="move_robot1_R1_PARK" robot_ns="robot1" operation_id="R1_PARK" operation_type="move" trajectory="{traj_robot1_R1_PARK}" hold_duration_s="0.5" velocity_scale="1.0" has_interlock="false"/>
        </Sequence>
        <Sequence>
          <WaitForRobot name="wait_robot1_parked" robot_ns="robot2" depends_on_joints="{deps_robot1_parked}"/>
          <ExecuteTrajectory name="weld_robot2_W02" robot_ns="robot2" operation_id="W02" operation_type="weld" trajectory="{traj_robot2_W02}" hold_duration_s="0.5" velocity_scale="1.0" has_interlock="false"/>
        </Sequence>
      </Parallel>
      <Parallel success_count="-1" failure_count="1">
        <MoveHome name="home_robot1" robot_ns="robot1" trajectory="{traj_robot1_home}"/>
        <MoveHome name="home_robot2" robot_ns="robot2" trajectory="{traj_robot2_home}"/>
      </Parallel>
    </Sequence>
  </BehaviorTree>
  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Action ID="ExecuteTrajectory">
      <input_port name="robot_ns"/>
      <input_port name="operation_id"/>
      <input_port name="operation_type" default="weld"/>
      <input_port name="trajectory"/>
      <input_port name="hold_duration_s" default="0.5"/>
      <input_port name="velocity_scale" default="1.0"/>
      <input_port name="has_interlock" default="false"/>
      <input_port name="interlock_target"/>
      <input_port name="depends_on_robots"/>
      <input_port name="depends_on_positions"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="MoveHome">
      <input_port name="robot_ns"/>
      <input_port name="trajectory"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="WaitForRobot">
      <input_port name="robot_ns"/>
      <input_port name="depends_on_robots"/>
      <input_port name="depends_on_joints"/>
      <input_port name="depends_on_positions"/>
      <input_port name="depends_on_ops"/>
    </Action>
    <Condition ID="CheckSafety">
      <input_port name="condition" default="estop_clear"/>
    </Condition>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>
